name: Bravo Internet
summary: Newcastle/Hunter dialup + broadband ISP (bravo.net.au, locally owned, PO Box 333 Merewether); retail service ran into 2023, then site reduced to webmail-only (BRAVO INTERNET PTY LTD, ACN 078 354 588).

events.details: BRAVO INTERNET PTY LTD, ACN 078 354 588, registered 29 Apr 1997. Earliest bravo.net.au capture 2 Mar 2000.

BRAVO Internet retail homepage (dialup/broadband plans, join, member services) captured live through 15 Jun 2023; by 25 Aug 2023 bravo.net.au was reduced to a Roundcube webmail login only (still webmail in 2026). Earlier 'c. 2005' death was wrong — the retail site ran ~13 years longer.
